text: This is one of the most whimsical things you can do in Los Angeles. This is Rocky Studios, tucked away inside of an enchanting treehouse studio in Silver Lake. They have workshops where you can design your own jewelry, keychains, and more with their incredible selection of beads and charms. You can spend hours creating your own custom pieces in the most peaceful, whimsical space surrounded by beautiful charms, pearls, and beads. It is the perfect excuse to unplug and get creative and heal your inner child. And of course, you can purchase pre-made or commission a custom piece. This is an activity that should be on everyone's Los Angeles bucket list. It is one of the most magical experiences you'll find in Los Angeles.
